name: lmtlss
description: LMTLSS — monorepo root scripts. Web reference app (index.html) has no build step; app/ (Expo), shared/ (pure domain TS) and server/ (dependency-free Worker API) each keep their own package.json.

scripts.test: npm --prefix shared test && npm --prefix app test && npm run test:server
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck && node --check server/src/worker.js
scripts.lint: npm --prefix shared run lint && npm --prefix app run lint
